```markdown
# SEC filing ingestion — Roadmap

> For agentic workers: REQUIRED SKILL: derive-roadmap — resume via its
> reconcile step; route each unticked stage per its ROUTING line; never plan
> this document wholesale.

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md (both PROPOSED, not accepted; both cover O1 only, and spec §2.2 puts O2 and O3 out of its scope).
Choices made: Python 3.14 (`.python-version`). A uv workspace of four package scaffolds: sec-edgar-client, sec-edgar-download, sec-edgar-index-ingest, sec-edgar-ingest (root `pyproject.toml`).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 requests/second (basis: SEC full-index and daily-index directories; rate from background spec §4.3). Measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks of downloading for the full history at 3 requests/second (basis: index row count times request rate; not yet measured). Measured by Stage 3 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk. Measured by Stage 5 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression).

## Stages

Order follows your ranking (O1 → O2 → O3), because each outcome consumes the one before it. Hardening stages come after O3 and run across all three outcomes. A core stage's Exit never requires them.

- [ ] Stage 1: Index core
      Objective: Ingest one real closed-quarter master index and one real daily master index into a filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: an index downloader and parser, a filing-index table, specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table holds the rows of both real sources, with row counts reported per source; the findings record bytes downloaded, row counts, elapsed time and peak memory of the real run
      Leaves out: full-history backfill and daily catch-up (Stage 2); raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance (Stage 6); quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); full validation suite (Stage 8); shared request budget, scheduling and deployment, monitoring and alerts (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Full-history backfill and daily catch-up
      Objective: Extend the filing-index table to the configured quarterly range and every daily index from the handoff date to the latest published one.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1 downloader, parser and table; Stage 1 findings
      Produces: a complete filing-index table over the configured range, resumable at the source-file level
      Exit: every quarterly and daily source in the range is in the table or listed as a failure; an interrupted run resumes without re-downloading completed sources; overlapping quarterly and daily rows appear once
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance (Stage 6); quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); full validation suite (Stage 8); shared request budget, scheduling and deployment, monitoring and alerts (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: Submissions slice
      Objective: Download the submissions named by the rows of one real daily index.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2 filing-index table
      Produces: a submission downloader, specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: every row of that index has its submission on disk or a reported failure; the findings record files, bytes, elapsed time, achieved request rate, and the extrapolated duration of the full history
      Leaves out: the full range (Stage 4); raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 8); shared request budget, scheduling and deployment, monitoring and alerts (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Submissions over the full range
      Objective: Download the submissions for every index row in a range chosen from the Stage 3 findings.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2 table; Stage 3 downloader and findings
      Produces: the submissions for the chosen range on disk, resumable
      Exit: every index row in the chosen range has its submission downloaded or a listed failure; an interrupted run resumes without refetching completed submissions
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 8); shared request budget, scheduling and deployment, monitoring and alerts (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 4 submissions on disk; Stage 2 table (form types)
      Produces: extracted 10-K and 8-K main documents, specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-5-findings.md
      Exit: each 10-K and 8-K in the downloaded range has its main document extracted or a listed failure; the findings record counts, bytes and elapsed time of the real run
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 8); scheduling and deployment (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Raw-snapshot replay, source manifest and provenance
      Objective: Make every derived output rebuildable from retained source bytes and traceable to its source.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–5 outputs
      Produces: retained raw snapshots, a source manifest, provenance on every derived row and extract
      Exit: with derived outputs removed and SEC access disabled, a rerun rebuilds an identical filing-index table and identical 10-K/8-K extracts; each row and extract names its source URL and content hash
      Leaves out: quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); full validation suite (Stage 8); scheduling and deployment (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Quarterly reconciliation
      Objective: Re-read closed-quarter indexes and account for later changes without losing the earlier version.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 6 raw snapshots and source manifest
      Produces: versioned filing-index quarters with change records
      Exit: a rerun over a changed quarterly index records the added, changed and removed rows against the prior version; the prior version stays readable; no removal takes effect without recorded approval
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 8); scheduling and deployment (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the historical formats and failure modes of all three outcomes with committed fixtures.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–7
      Produces: a CI suite that runs on fixtures and mocked SEC responses
      Exit: CI passes on fixtures that span the index formats in the configured range, the submission and 10-K/8-K document variants seen in Stages 3–5, and the failure responses met so far; CI makes no SEC request
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 9)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 9: Shared request budget, scheduling and deployment, monitoring and alerts
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and reconciliation on a schedule on a chosen platform (the Azure ADR in specs/ is proposed, not accepted).
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–8
      Produces: a deployed, scheduled system with alerts
      Exit: scheduled runs are observed in their reports; concurrent runs stay under the configured SEC request target; an injected failure fires an alert
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

When every stage is ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list (O1–O3), with evidence per verdict from the implementing stage plans, Deviation notes and `specs/deferred_items.md`. Each unmet outcome exits as a new stage or as a conscious deferral with a written reason.
```
